quests.title: Mondstadt and its Archon

dialogue.t: Lord Barbatos, I hope that you can hear me...
Have you gathered the Dandelion Seeds?
These should be enough. Please wait here for a moment...
Wow, she's so... devout. So... many words...
Who knows if that Tone-Deaf Bard is listening...
Alright. Please take these dandelions seeds. Help me go up and scatter them.
I should really do this myself, but with my physical abilities... I would probably have a hard time getting back down, even if I could climb up there.
Have you scattered the Dandelion Seeds?

dialogue.sit: The wind will carry them far abroad.

dialogue.t: Regardless, I do hope that Lord Barbatos will be able to hear my voice.
Thank you for your willingness to help. Please take this for your troubles — and may the Anemo Archon protect you.

quests.description: Now that Mondstadt has been spared from disaster, Sister Grace would like to offer her thanks to the Anemo Archon for its protection of the city.
